sources.title: Innovations in toilet design — The National Archives

notes: 1596年对应哈林顿公开设计的现代水厕前身，不代表人类第一次以水排污；更早的厕所与排水系统已有考古记录。卡明1775年的贡献是水封弯管等结构的专利改良。现代抽水马桶由多人持续改进，不能把哈林顿、卡明或克拉珀称为所有水冲厕所的唯一发明者。
notes_en: The 1596 date concerns Harington’s published precursor to the modern toilet, not humanity’s first use of water to remove waste; earlier toilets and drainage systems are archaeologically documented. Cumming’s 1775 contribution was a patent improvement involving a water-filled trap and other details. Modern flush toilets developed through many improvements: Harington, Cumming and Crapper should not be called the sole inventor of all flushing toilets.
summary_zh: 1596年，哈林顿公开了带冲洗系统和阀门的水厕设计。1775年，卡明为带水封弯管的改良结构取得英国专利，以存水阻隔臭气，成为现代抽水马桶发展的重要节点。
summary_en: Harington published a flushing toilet with a valve in 1596. Cumming’s 1775 British patent used a water-filled trap to block odors, a key step toward the modern flush toilet.
summary_ja: 1596年、Harington が洗浄機構と弁を備えた便器の設計を公表した。1775年には Cumming が、水をためた曲管で臭気を遮る改良構造の英国特許を取得し、現代の水洗便器の発展における重要な節目となった。
